userReference.description: The internal user reference for this depot. Typically a employee or student id of the system

authValues.description: auth values to use for authenticating the user or session. For an issuer service with internal `verifiable_presentation` auth, one value per rule of its `verifiablePresentationAuthRules`, at the rule's `valueIndex`. Each value must have its rule's `valueType`, and its `valueFormat` if the rule has one, and a string must not be blank. Strings are trimmed and lower-cased before they are checked and matched, and numbers and booleans are used as they are. Values of different types never match, so `"12345"` never matches `12345`.

deferredCredentials.description: Whether the depot's credentials may come later. A wallet with nothing to claim then waits until depots/resolve-deferred-credentials is called. Only allowed for issuer service depots, and can't be changed

expectedCredentialTypes.description: The credential types the depot may receive
